intro.kicker: Aspiring Data Scientist | AI & Machine Learning | Generative AI
intro.prose: Hi, I'm Priyanshu Kumar, a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering student specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at Sandip University.

sections.whoIAm: I have a growing passion for Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Generative AI. I enjoy working with Python, analyzing datasets, developing machine learning models, and building intelligent applications that solve practical problems.
sections.technicalInterests: Through my internships and hands-on projects, I have explored data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, model development, AI applications, and full-stack development. I'm also exploring Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, AI Agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), APIs, and MLOps to understand how intelligent systems are developed and deployed in real-world environments.
sections.leadership: Beyond technical learning, I serve as a Class Representative and have experience leading project teams, coordinating activities, collaborating with developers, and managing responsibilities. One of my memorable achievements was securing a TOP 3 position in CHECKMATE during our three-month CRT journey with Team Impact Crew and our project DORMIQ.
sections.careerGoals: My goal is to grow into a skilled Data Scientist who can transform complex data into meaningful insights and build impactful, data-driven solutions. I believe in continuous learning, practical implementation, teamwork, and building technology that makes a difference.

principles.title: Build by hand
principles.desc: Start with a small working interface. Extract a component once a second screen needs it.

principles.title: Measure the work
principles.desc: Trace the slow request from the browser to the database before changing the query.

principles.title: Give motion a job
principles.desc: Use movement to show which project is in focus and where the next one begins.

principles.title: Design for a phone
principles.desc: Check controls, reading order, and load time on the screen a visitor actually uses.

principles.title: Leave a clear trail
principles.desc: Give functions plain names and keep the reason for each technical decision close to the code.

dossierSummary: I'm a third-year Computer Science and Engineering student specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. I'm building my technical foundation in Python, SQL, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning. I enjoy practical implementation, problem-solving, and developing intelligent applications. I'm continuously exploring Generative AI, Large Language Models, and modern AI technologies while working towards my goal of becoming a Data Scientist.

highlights: Worked as a Data Science Intern, gaining hands-on exposure to data analysis, dataset preprocessing, and analytical problem-solving.
Engineered data-driven solutions and performed exploratory data analysis (EDA) using Python, Pandas, and visualization libraries.
Participated in an intensive Artificial Intelligence summer internship involving core AI concepts and team collaboration.
Engaged in project development activities, AI model workflows, and technical project management skills.
